bio.text: James Macon III is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Tennessee in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to Ballotpedia, he served in the U.S. Air National Guard in 2010 and his career experience includes working as an executive director.
He graduated from East St. Louis Sr. High School and earned graduate degrees from Northern Illinois University (2002) and the University of Tennessee (2005).
